# Maintained shop starting state

This fixture inherits the original `ts-shop` file list and overlays only the completed existing-project setup files.
The overlay was installed through the public protected `apply` command by replaying the [completed existing-project plan](../../eval/results/full-path-C27/runs/2026-10-11T09-23-18.776Z-5bf45472-6fcb-488d-9f4f-d51ad8307805/artifacts/4b72d6c7-implementation-plan.json) and its selected findings on a fresh original fixture.
The replay binds the fresh root, original bytes and published proposed bytes to a new digest; it does not reuse the historical plan's redacted digest as an executable approval.
The checker proposal was regenerated through `node scripts/generate-checker.mjs --repo <target> --json` from current sources before the protected installation.
The generated contract is the existing-project plan's exact payload, not a separate handwritten maintenance contract.

The endpoint fixture supplies the approved 10 while the public quote remains 12.
Web imports use the public core interface, the core cycle is removed, and the original assertions remain unchanged.
The aggregate runs types, units, native boundary enforcement and the real loopback checkout journey.
The initial committed state is the maintenance comparison base, selected explicitly as `HEAD` before the bounded refactor.
Sanity requires every original protection to pass, authoritative acceptance excerpts to exist, the installed generated checker to be present and a clean working tree.
The scenario names an intermediate undiscounted pricing total without changing behaviour or cosmetically editing documents.
